sprint_goal: Convert the governed next-build candidate into a proof-bound MVP sprint path without claiming external validation.

work_packages.name: Trust dossier manifest compiler
work_packages.purpose: Compile product identity, intended audience, evidence scope, authority boundary, and output contract into a deterministic dossier manifest.

work_packages.name: Evidence spine binder
work_packages.purpose: Bind source receipts, prior proof packs, product claims, disclaimers, and forbidden claims into a dossier evidence spine.

work_packages.name: Dossier renderer surface
work_packages.purpose: Render a human-reviewable dossier draft with claim-safe executive summary, proof numbers, source hashes, and boundary warnings.

work_packages.name: Claim audit evaluator
work_packages.purpose: Evaluate generated dossier language against allowed claims, forbidden claims, authority locks, and marketing-safe boundaries.

work_packages.name: Sprint demo harness
work_packages.purpose: Provide a deterministic local demo harness that exercises manifest compile, evidence bind, render, and claim audit without publication.
